What the service helps with
Old Google results, articles, reviews, snippets, associated names, business reputation issues and weak positive search footprints.
Start privately
Use the Free Search Snapshot™ to show what appears before deciding what to do next.
No guaranteed outcomes
No responsible search or reputation service can guarantee Google ranking, removal, de-indexing or platform decisions.

Map the result page, classify each issue, then choose monitoring, review defence, removal review or repair planning.
faqs: Can FixMyNameOnline™ remove every result?

No. Search engines, publishers and platforms make their own decisions. The useful first step is a private map of what appears and which removal, de-indexing, review, privacy or positive-footprint pathways may be realistic.
Is the first step private?

What if a result cannot be removed?
Then the strategy usually shifts to accurate, approved search-footprint assets, monitoring, and practical search protection so one bad result is not the whole story.

google-your-name-before-a-job-interview.title: Google Your Name Before a Job Interview — Private Search Snapshot | Fix My Name Online™
google-your-name-before-a-job-interview.h1: Google your name before a job interview: what to check privately
google-your-name-before-a-job-interview.description: A private FixMyNameOnline™ guide for job seekers worried that employers may find old articles, bad snippets, reviews, court mentions or confusing search results.
google-your-name-before-a-job-interview.intro: Before an employer decides whether to call back, they may quietly search your name. If the first page shows an old article, bad snippet, review, public record or confusing association, you need a calm private map before you react publicly.
sections: Check what an employer actually sees
Search your full name, old names, location, business names and common variants. Capture the URL, title, snippet and ranking position for anything that could create hesitation.
Separate fixable issues from reputation gaps
Some pages may support removal, correction, noindex, outdated-content or platform-reporting requests. Others may require truthful positive assets that show the current professional picture.
Do not create more searchable panic

Avoid public explanation posts that repeat the damaging terms. A private snapshot helps decide what to request, what to ignore, and what current assets should exist before the interview process moves further.
Use current professional assets
LinkedIn, business profiles, current biographies, portfolio pages, interviews and owned pages can help searchers see a fuller current picture over time.
Keep expectations realistic
No service can guarantee what an employer sees or how Google ranks results. The useful work is evidence, pathway review, current assets and monitoring.
faqs: Can bad Google results cost me a job?
They can influence trust before you get a chance to explain, but employers vary. The safer move is to know what appears and prepare a private plan.
Should I explain the result in the interview?
That depends on the result and context. First map the search issue privately so you do not repeat harmful terms unnecessarily.
Can FixMyNameOnline guarantee removal?
No. It provides private review, evidence mapping and practical next-step options, not guaranteed removal or rankings.

old-news-article-still-ranking-for-my-na.title: Old News Article Still Ranking for My Name — What Can I Do? | Fix My Name Online™
old-news-article-still-ranking-for-my-na.h1: Old news article still ranking for your name: private next steps
old-news-article-still-ranking-for-my-na.description: A private guide to old news articles still ranking for a name search: publisher requests, Google pathways, positive search footprint and monitoring.
old-news-article-still-ranking-for-my-na.intro: An old news article can keep ranking long after the situation has changed. To a stranger, it may look current. The first step is evidence: what ranks, what it says, who controls it and what options may realistically exist.
sections: Capture the article and search context
Record the URL, headline, publication date, Google snippet, search query and where it ranks. Check whether copies, archives or scraped versions also appear.
Consider publisher and Google pathways
Depending on the facts, options may include correction, update, anonymisation, noindex, outdated-content review or specific Google removal tools. Not every article qualifies.
Build the current picture
If removal is not realistic, approved current profiles, business pages, helpful articles and social/entity assets can help show more than one old result.
Avoid hostile public contact
A rushed angry email can make the issue harder. A structured request is calmer, specific and evidence-led.
Monitor for recrawls and copies
Old content can reappear through archives, snippets and copied pages. Monitoring helps spot changes before someone else does.
faqs: Can Google remove an old news article?
Sometimes specific Google pathways may apply, but many news articles require publisher action or broader search-footprint work.
What if the publisher refuses?
Then the strategy may shift toward accurate current assets, monitoring and any other legitimate pathway available.
Is this legal advice?
No. FixMyNameOnline is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice.

fix-my-search-results-before-clients-see.h1: Fix your search results before clients see them
fix-my-search-results-before-clients-see.description: A private guide for founders, consultants and businesses worried clients may see negative, outdated or confusing Google results before buying.
fix-my-search-results-before-clients-see.intro: Clients often search quietly before booking, referring or signing. If your name or business shows old articles, bad reviews, complaint pages or weak current profiles, the sale may be damaged before the call starts.
sections: Audit the buyer search journey
Search your name, brand, founder name, service plus reviews, complaints and location terms. Note what a cautious buyer would see first.
Prioritise commercial-risk results
A bad review snippet, old article or confusing association near a buying decision is more urgent than a low-risk deep result.
Create current trust assets
Service pages, founder profiles, case-style articles, FAQs, review responses and strong business listings can help buyers see the current picture.
Review removal and response pathways
Some review or page issues may support platform reports, evidence packs, publisher requests or response planning.
Keep it private and practical
The goal is not panic. The goal is to map the risk, choose the right pathway and monitor changes.
faqs: Can search results affect sales?
Yes. Buyers may quietly search before they contact you or after a sales conversation.
Should I respond to every bad review?
Not automatically. Preserve evidence and choose the safest response or reporting path.
What is the first FMNO step?
Start with a Free Search Snapshot so the visible risk can be mapped privately.
